title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section V – Court of Auditors
part_text: ‘underlines that such scrutiny is crucial to ensure that Union funds are not diverted, directly or indirectly, to terrorist organisations or their affiliates, nor used in a manner that promotes hatred, radicalisation, or incitement to violence, and to ensure full compliance with Union financial rules, transparency standards, and the Union’s core values;’
